statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and dizziness
There is clinical concern for paroxysmal supraventricular tachycardia
The diagnosis code for paroxysmal supraventricular tachycardia is I47.1
The patient has a history of transient cerebral ischemic attacks
The claim was denied under reason code CO-22
Prolonged ambulatory monitoring via CPT 93229 is medically necessary to correlate cardiac rhythm disturbances with neurological symptoms and dizziness
